source.title: Symphony No. 5, Op. 67 — first movement
source.encoder: Stelios Samelis; LilyPond 2.16.2 adaptation by Johannes Heinecke

method: Public-domain LilyPond/MIDI → voice-aware performed event table; tuning estimated with librosa; Sync Toolbox 1.4.2 memory-restricted multiscale DTW at 50 frames/s, chroma + DLNCO. First/last attacks anchored by score-pitch energy rises in documented inspection windows; section anchors refined by DTW and checked against existing passage labels. Note-offs are warped notation, not measured key releases; final holds extend to a documented pitch-energy display boundary, not a measured key release. No aural review. See tools/align/REPORT.md. Additional internal score attacks are pinned by documented score-pitch energy windows; these are not independent listening annotations.
repeats: Disc side 1 of 2: the exposition, bars 1–124, with its written repeat, then the development and the opening of the recapitulation through the bar-251–252 D fermata, where this side's music stops. The recording continues on a separate side; bars 253–502 are not part of this recording.
